text: We will most likely stay at another La Quinta by Wyndham. We found the place very clean & well air conditioned. We did not find anything we didn’t like.

Great price great area one block from boardwalk & Tramcar. Can’t beat the price. Great for kids it’s a “U” shape motel with pool in the middle so your kids are always in sight if you’re enjoying drinks in front of your room door chairs. Air conditioner & little stuff alittle run down but one block from boardwalk/convention ctr makes it all a great value. Very tight free area in room very small living quarters but we only used it to sleep

Value for money. Cheap and close to airport, bus station and many cafe also having 7Eleven For my room, I dont like that my double room didnt have desk. It make me put our things and stuff on the floor

- staff very friendfull, helpfull and very kind - the entire hotel and rooms was clean - good and consistent breakfast - EXCELENT LOCATION - 2 min walk to Blue Mosque or Hagia Sophia - the roof terrace is awesome - view to both mosques For the ones 1st time in Istanbul, valid for the entire area and for all hotels and can be a minus for some people (it wasn't for us): - the rooms and buildings are small in the historycal area - in the night the public service are active and it can be noisy - around 4:30 am the first prayer call starts and can be disturbing for the ones with light sleep - the entire area is crowded with tourists so be patient - don't try to use personal car for visiting, you will end up in traffic jams especially in historycal area - choose wisely restaurants, try to find the ones where local people is eating.

The location was good. It was really close to the tourist places. It was hard to reach the bed. I got the bed on the top so it was kinda difficult. Luckily, there was an available bed ( not on the top) where I slept :).

Good, but it can be improved. Stuff is amazing. Rumesh made us feel like at home. Bed is comfortable, there is more than enough space in room. Location is a far away from the centre. You need 15 minutes walk to the metro station then additional 45 minutes to the city centre. Isolation doesnt exist. You hear every steps, every noise. Breakfast could be a bit better. Not a lot of choise.
Location & price No housekeeping Bathroom door could not be locked & would open by itself

It's well located although the immediate surroundings are not nice at night. The gym is not open 24hrs (only from 9am to 10pm) which makes it difficult to use if you have a tour. The bedroom and bathroom are too small

felt like home. - close to train station ,convenient stores and supermarkets - enough utensils that you can buy materials in supermarkets and cook yourself a dinner - cozy and beautiful - comfortable bed - have washing machine and iron - small toilet, but the living room is big so I am okay with that - late check in time and early check out time - the dining table is too low. I guess it is a Japanese style table, but I cannot get used to it
Was on the sea front Hotel was ok but bathroom was very small.

Unable to leave a tip for the cleaning staff. (or we couldn't find a way - we don't carry cash). we checked in using the kiosk, no mess, no fuss. All was seof serving for our overnight stay. There was a window on the shower wall, that looked onto the bedroom area (King size bed) we thought that was kind of wierd. We are married so it didn't matter to us, but we often stay with our grandkids and THAT would have been uncomfortable (disturbing)

very close to ski lift, shops & restaurants can hear neighbors TV (till 3am) & above room people walking in ski boots for an hour. also was hot in room thankfully there was a door to open & let in cool air.
